page: Swagger plugin deprecated, use OpenAPI instead. Generates Swagger endpoint for Elysia server. Install @elysia/swagger. Accessing /swagger shows Scalar UI with documentation. /swagger/json for raw OpenAPI spec. Config: provider default 'scalar', scalar customization, swagger customization, excludeStaticFile default true, path default '/swagger', exclude array of paths. Tags for grouping endpoints. Security configuration with Bearer JWT. Deprecation warning recommend OpenAPI plugin.

sections.manifest: Config options. Provider default 'scalar' for UI. Scalar config object for customization. Swagger config for OpenAPI v2. ExcludeStaticFile default true. Path default '/swagger'. Exclude paths string/RegExp/array.
Change Swagger endpoint path. path property in config. /v2/swagger custom endpoint.
Customize Swagger info. Documentation info object with title, version. Swagger configuration customization.
Tags for endpoint grouping. Tags array in swagger documentation. Detail tags property for route assignment. Group endpoints by tag categories.
Security configuration. Bearer JWT scheme. SecuritySchemes definition. Prefix detail property security field. All routes under prefix require JWT.
